Her work often invokes themes of science fiction, feminism, and fantasy.

Valerie Teicher Barbosa (born 4 October 1989), best known by her stage name Tei Shi, born in Argentina, is a Colombian-Canadian, singer, songwriter, and record producer based in New York City.
She released her first singles and music videos in 2013, also performing live for the first time at CMJ.
